If you have any questions, please contact our Customer Care Unit with reference to case CASE-05.

Yours faithfully,
Revenue Billing Analyst

Dear Sabon Gari Cold Room,

Our internal audit has reviewed your account for the period when meter access was unavailable from September through December 2025. During those four months, we billed you on estimates of 300 kWh per month.

We recognize that this under-recovery occurred because we could not access your meter during the estimated period. Under our policy, we are entitled to recover this amount, and we will add it to your account. To ease the impact, we are offering you an instalment plan to spread this amount over three months at NGN 20,406.00 per month, in addition to your regular monthly bill.

If you would like to discuss the instalment arrangement or have questions about the reconciliation, please contact our Customer Care Unit within 14 days of this notice.

Thank you for your understanding.

Billing Operations

This adjustment requires approval from our Revenue Assurance Manager and will be processed within 10 working days. You will receive a revised statement once the correction is posted.

Regards,
Billing Dispute Resolution Unit
